proof.text: Take the ordinary injective resolution of O_Y and extend it by zero to integer degrees (Mathlib InjectiveResolution.cochainComplex and ι'). It is strictly concentrated in degrees >= 0 and K-injective by CochainComplex.isKInjective_of_injective. The representative comparison derivedInternalHom_obj_iso computes RHom from i_*O_Z[0] by the internal Hom complex into this resolution.

Apply homComplex_single_iso to identify this with degreewise internal Hom from i_*O_Z. Additivity in the target preserves zero objects, so this complex is strictly concentrated in degrees >=0. DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isGE makes its q-th homology zero for q<0.
Unfold locallyRankedExteriorTerm: its q<0 branch is zero. Pushforward, being additive, preserves this zero object. Use IsZero.iso to identify the two zero sheaves.

title: Koszul-regular immersion Ext sheaf negative-degree comparison (q < 0)
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Set $C=i^*\ker(i)$ using [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] and [def-pc-module-pullback], and $N=\mathcal Hom(C,\mathcal O_Z)$ using [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. Let $r:Z\to\mathbb N$ be any locally constant function. For every integer $q<0$, in the derived category of module sheaves on $Y$ [def-pc-derived-category], $H^q(R\mathcal Hom_Y(i_*\mathcal O_Z,\mathcal O_Y))\cong i_*T^q(N,r)$, using [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex]. Both sides are zero. No immersion, regularity, or equality between r and conormal rank is assumed.

theorem koszulRegularImmersion_extSheaf_negative
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (r : LocallyConstant Z ℕ)
    {q : ℤ} (hq : q < 0) :
    Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) q).obj
        ((derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj
          (op ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))),
            (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
                (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf))) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj
        (Scheme.Modules.locallyRankedExteriorTerm
          (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := Z.sheaf)
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)
            (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)) r q))
